# CityClick (cityclick.com)
> The Deterministic B2B City & Commercial Location Intelligence Platform

## Project Overview
CityClick is the authority engine for US municipal demographics, commercial asking rents, NAICS retail saturation indices, and municipal permit requirements. Built for multi-unit franchisees, commercial tenant brokers, and SBA lenders.

## Core Methodologies & Provenance
- Zero-Hallucination Policy: All metrics are anchored to primary authoritative federal and municipal records:
  - Demographics: US Census Bureau ACS 5-Year (DP03/DP04/DP05)
  - Business Establishment Counts: US Census Bureau Zip Codes Business Patterns (ZBP)
  - Labor & Unemployment: Bureau of Labor Statistics LAUS
  - Building Permits: US Census Bureau Building Permits Survey (BPS)
  - Hazard Vulnerability: FEMA National Risk Index
- CityClick Business Viability Score™ (0–100):
  - ECDF mid-rank percentile aggregation across 4 core dimensions:
    - Purchasing Power (25%): 70% Median Household Income + 30% Daytime Worker Surge
    - Growth Momentum (30%): 55% 5-Yr Population Growth + 45% Permits per 1k Residents
    - Cost Efficiency (25%): 50% Income-to-Rent Ratio + 30% Low Unemployment + 20% FEMA Resilience
    - Regulatory Friction (20%): 65% Low Sales Tax + 35% Short Permit Review Turnaround
- Empirical Bayes NAICS Saturation Index (100 = US Benchmark):
  - Uses empirical Bayes shrinkage (m = 10,000 prior) against 25 small-business NAICS codes.
  - Classification:
    - Underserved: < 80
    - Balanced: 80 - 120
    - Saturated: > 120

## Key URLs & Resource Structure
- Homepage & Screener: https://cityclick.com/
- City Feasibility Dossiers: https://cityclick.com/{stateCode}/{citySlug}
  - Austin, TX: https://cityclick.com/tx/austin
  - Tampa, FL: https://cityclick.com/fl/tampa
  - Boise, ID: https://cityclick.com/id/boise
- Comparative Underwriting: https://cityclick.com/compare/{stateA}-{cityA}-vs-{stateB}-{cityB}
  - Austin vs Tampa: https://cityclick.com/compare/tx-austin-vs-fl-tampa
- Commercial Lease Calculator: https://cityclick.com/tools/lease-calculator
- Full Methodology & Benchmarks: https://cityclick.com/llms-full.txt
- OpenAPI 3.1 Specification: https://cityclick.com/openapi.json

## Public Edge API Endpoints
- GET /api/v1/cities/{stateCode}/{citySlug}
  Returns full verified JSON dossier with provenance metadata.
- GET /api/v1/screen?minPopulation=200000&maxRent=35
  Filter US cities by feasibility score, retail rent, and saturation.
